purpose: After the exact-day negative result is frozen, test preregistered plus/minus 1-day and plus/minus 3-day observation-opportunity windows and compare any overlap against a deterministic calendar null that preserves the full three-date Oak Ridge primary pattern.

primary_cohort_contract.include: Only rows from the frozen Oak Ridge earth ledger with bridge_eligible=true.
primary_cohort_contract.exclusion_reason: The October 16 row remains provisional because primary-page authority is pending; it may be reported descriptively but must not enter the primary null statistic.

window_contract.hit_definition: An Earth event is a window hit iff at least one materialized Palomar observation-day row falls inside the inclusive plus/minus radius around the Earth date.
window_contract.no_observation_law: No Palomar row inside a window means no observation opportunity in this materialized POSS-I cohort, never an observed zero sky.

calendar_null_contract.name: RIGID_CLUSTER_TRANSLATION_EXHAUSTIVE
calendar_null_contract.construction: Translate all three primary Earth dates by the same integer number of days. Evaluate every integer shift for which the widest preregistered window (plus/minus 3 days) around every translated date remains fully inside the Palomar study window.
preserves: same Palomar observation schedule and gaps
report: fraction of feasible shifts with statistic >= actual
fraction of feasible shifts with statistic <= actual
fraction of feasible shifts with zero event hits

decision_contract.if_actual_overlap_present: Report observation-opportunity overlap and its exact empirical rarity under the frozen rigid-translation null. Do not infer common cause.
decision_contract.if_actual_overlap_absent: Report the branch as window-negative for observation opportunity and report how common a zero is under the calendar null; do not reinterpret no observation as observed zero.
decision_contract.multiple_windows: Both radii are preregistered before execution and must be reported together; neither may be hidden after seeing the result.

claim_ceiling: R3 tests temporal observation-opportunity coincidence only. It cannot establish or refute UAP identity, nonhuman origin, nuclear attraction, a physical Earth-space link, or causal coupling.
canonical_seal: MOVE THE WHOLE EARTH DATE PATTERN, NOT THE GOALPOSTS. WINDOW FIRST, NULL FIRST, INTERPRETATION LAST.
